inspector.evidence: The pinned official CLI initializes the production Streamable HTTP runtime fixture and performs tools/list over a bound session. The bearer token it presents was produced by the test harness through RFC 7591 dynamic client registration followed by an Owner consent, with no client pre-registered, and is then placed in the Inspector's configuration as a static Authorization header.
inspector.boundary: Deterministic loopback fixture only; no live client, external account, or production installation is claimed. The Inspector's own OAuth client is NOT exercised: it cannot complete an Owner consent without a browser. The registration, PKCE authorize, consent and token-exchange steps are proved instead by the scripted OAuth client below, which speaks HTTP to the same runtime.

tested.how: Runs against the production HTTP runtime on a loopback socket. Its bearer token comes from dynamic client registration plus Owner consent, not from a pre-registered client. The token is injected as a static header; the Inspector's own OAuth client does not run, because completing an Owner consent needs a browser.
tested.evidence: apps/reference-site/src/mcp-http-runtime.test.ts::is discoverable by the pinned official MCP Inspector over Streamable HTTP

tested.client: Scripted OAuth 2.1 client written for this repository
tested.how: Speaks HTTP to the runtime on a loopback socket and performs protected resource metadata discovery, authorization server metadata discovery, RFC 7591 registration, authorize with PKCE S256, Owner consent, token exchange, initialize and tools/list.
tested.evidence: apps/reference-site/src/mcp-http-runtime.test.ts::lets a scripted OAuth client discover, register, consent and list tools over HTTP
